source.title: Open problems from the 2nd International Conference on Fuzzy Sets Theory and Its Applications

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as a zbMATH resolver URL with trailing identifier 1064262. Local resolver metadata in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identified the exact work as "Open problems from the 2nd International Conference on Fuzzy Sets Theory and Its Applications" with DOI 10.1016/0165-0114(95)00209-X.

failure_mode=network_or_dns_failure. Local Bash fetches of https://zbmath.org/1064262, https://api.zbmath.org/v1/document/1064262, and https://doi.org/ failed with DNS resolution errors in the sandbox, so browser/search recovery and local resolver metadata were used only for identity recovery.
evidence_refs: curl: Could not resolve host: zbmath.org
curl: Could not resolve host: api.zbmath.org
curl: Could not resolve host: doi.org

trace.notes: failure_mode=paywalled_or_restricted. Exact DOI and exact-title search results identified the ScienceDirect article page for Fuzzy Sets and Systems 81(2), pages 185-190, but the page exposed access-through-organization messaging and first-page-preview/View PDF affordances rather than a readable full-text artifact available to this workflow.

failure_mode=metadata_only. CiNii and later FSTA open-problem pages confirmed the same title, authors, journal, pages, DOI, MR/Zbl references, or citations, but did not provide the 1996 article body containing the original problem statements. Exact-work searches by DOI, PII, title plus PDF, and title plus authors did not recover a readable same-work PDF or full HTML source.
No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the article body was recovered, so document mapping and candidate extraction were not performed.

No accepted questions were produced because the source could not be normalized to a readable primary artifact. Resolver metadata, abstracts, citation records, search snippets, and later citing papers were rejected under the source adequacy and no-new-facts gates.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath_1064262.json and updated outputs/latest.json.
